ex.s: In front of me was an array of foods I couldn’t even name in my native language.
ex.t: 摆在我面前的是一系列我用母语都叫不出名字的食物。

ex.s: Unfortunately, between us stood the barrier of language.
ex.t: 不幸的是，我们之间横亘着语言的障碍。

ex.s: I watched with great sympathy as elderly Italians tried to hold a conversation in Italian with people who did not speak the language.
ex.t: 我满怀同情地看着年长的意大利人试图用意大利语与不懂这门语言的人交谈。

ex.s: It suddenly became very clear to me how lucky I was to be fluent in two languages.
ex.t: 我突然非常清楚地意识到我能流利地说两种语言是多么幸运。

ex.s: In a study led by Ellen Langer of Harvard University, researchers asked people to translate sentences into a new a made-up language.
ex.t: 在哈佛大学的艾伦·兰格领导的一项研究中，研究人员让人们把句子翻译成一种新编出来的语言。

ex.s: Subjects who practiced the language moderately beforehand made fewer errors than those who practiced extensively or not at all.
ex.t: 事先适度练习这种语言的人犯的错误比那些大量练习或根本不练习的人少。

ex.s: The very best communicators are those who know how to adjust their language to match their audience.
ex.t: 最好的沟通者是那些知道如何根据读者调整语言的人。

ex.s: Travellers need to know a second language.
ex.t: 旅行者需要懂一门第二语言。

ex.s: We spoke our own language.
ex.t: 我们说着自己的语言。

ex.s: Children should learn a second language.
ex.t: 孩子应该学一门第二语言。

ex.s: Language is certainly a barrier for many people.
ex.t: 语言对许多人来说无疑是个障碍。

ex.s: For postcrossing to work worldwide, a common communication language is needed so that everyone can understand each other.
ex.t: 要让明信片交流在全球范围内运作，需要一种通用的交流语言，以便大家相互理解。

ex.s: 34   So a common language is required and in postcrossing that’s English since it’s widely spoken.
ex.t: 34   因此需要一种通用语言，而在明信片交流中这种语言就是英语，因为它被广泛使用。

ex.s: We did not speak the local language, did not know the customs, and more often than not, did not entirely recognize the food.
ex.t: 我们不会说当地语言，不了解当地习俗，而且往往认不出食物。

ex.s: We all spoke the same language of passes and shots.
ex.t: 我不擅长足球，但那个晚上很美好。

ex.s: He learned more about the local language.
ex.t: 他更多地了解了当地的语言。

ex.s: Lancom is a worldwide language learning app and a leader in the online language learning industry with millions of active subscribers.
ex.t: Lancom是一款全球语言学习应用，也是在线语言学习行业的领导者，拥有数百万活跃订阅用户。

ex.s: We house a broad range of experts united by the common goal of creating the best language learning tools possible.
ex.t: 我们汇聚了众多专家，他们因创造尽可能好的语言学习工具这一共同目标而团结在一起。

ex.s: At the core of Lancom is a world-class effective method that enhances language leaning with advanced technology.
ex.t: Lancom的核心是一种世界级的有效方法，借助先进技术提升语言学习。

ex.s: The app makes our practical language lessons available wherever and whenever.
ex.t: 这款应用程序让我们的实用语言课程随时随地可用。

ex.s: Millions of learners have their own stories and their own reasons for learning a new language.
ex.t: Lancom是唯一提供根据你的母语定制的课程的产品，基于你已经知道的语法和词汇构建。

ex.s: Learning English as a second language can be a painful experience.
ex.t: 把英语作为第二语言来学可能是一段痛苦的经历。

ex.s: Languages have been coming and going for thousands of years, but in recent times there has been less coming and a lot more going.
ex.t: 语言来来去去已有数千年，但近来越来越少有新语言出现，却有大量语言消失。

ex.s: Some language experts believe that 10,000 years ago, when the world had just five to ten million people, they spoke perhaps 12,000 languages between them.
ex.t: 一些语言专家认为，一万年前，当世界只有五百到一千万人时，他们之间可能讲着一万两千种语言。

ex.s: Soon afterwards, many of those people started settling down to become farmers, and their languages too became more settled and fewer in number.
ex.t: 不久之后，那些人中的许多开始定居下来成为农民，他们的语言也随之变得更加稳定，数量也减少了。

ex.s: Especially glbalisation and better communications in the past few decades, all have caused many Languages to disappear, and dominant languages such as English.
ex.t: 尤其是近几十年的全球化和更好的通讯方式，都导致许多语言消失，而英语等主导语言正在日益占据主导地位。

ex.s: At present, the world has about 6,800 languages.
ex.t: 目前，世界约有6800种语言。

ex.s: The distribution of these languages is hugely uneven.
ex.t: 这些语言的分布极不均匀。

ex.s: The general rule is that mild zones have relatively few languages.
ex.t: 一般规律是温带地区的语言相对较少。

ex.s: Europe has only around 200 Languages: the Americas about 1,000.
ex.t: 欧洲只有约200种语言；美洲约1000种。

ex.s: What can we infer about languages in huntergatherer times?
ex.t: 关于狩猎采集时代的语言，我们能推断出什么？

ex.s: How many languages are spoken by less than 6,000 people at present?
ex.t: 目前有多少种语言的使用者少于6000人？

ex.s: New languages will be created.
ex.t: 新语言将会被创造出来。

ex.s: Peoples lifestyles are reflected in languages
ex.t: 人们的生活方式反映在语言中

ex.s: Human development results in fewer languages
ex.t: 人类的发展导致语言数量减少。

ex.s: Geography determines language evolution.
ex.t: 地理决定语言进化。

ex.s: Before there was the written word, there was the language of dance.

ex.s: The word history of typhoon had a far less direct path to the English language than gung-ho.
ex.t: typhoon一词进入英语的路径远比gung-ho间接得多。

ex.s: But, according to the Merriam-Webster New Book of Word Histories, the first typhoons reported in the English language were in India and were called “touffons” or “tufans,” The word tufan or al-tufan is Arabic and means violent storm or flood.
ex.t: 但根据《梅里亚姆-韦伯斯特词源新词典》，英语中最早报道的台风在印度，被称为“touffons”或“tufans”。“tufan”或“al-tufan”一词是阿拉伯语，意思是猛烈的风暴或洪水。

ex.s: “It takes a lot for any student，” Whaley explains，“especially for a student who is learning English as their new language，to feel confident enough to say，‘I don’t know，but I want to know.’”
ex.t: “对任何学生来说都需要很大勇气，”惠利解释道，“尤其对一个把英语当作新语言来学的学生，要自信到能说‘我不知道，但我想知道’。”

ex.s: The Moldovan has lived here seven years as a caregiver to Italian kids and the elderly, but in order to stay she’s had to prove her language skills by taking a test which requires her to write a postcard to an imaginary friend and answer a fictional job ad.
ex.t: 这位摩尔多瓦人作为意大利孩子和老人的照护者已在这里住了七年，但为了留下来，她必须通过一项测试来证明自己的语言能力——测试要求她给一个想象中的朋友写明信片，并回复一则虚构的招聘广告。

ex.s: Others say it’s only natural that newcomers learn the language of their host nation, seeing it as a condition to ensure they can contribute to society.
ex.t: 另一些人说，新来者学习所在国的语言是再自然不过的事，他们把这看作是为了确保自己能为社会做贡献的一个条件。

ex.s: According to Chart 2, which language has the largest number of learners?
ex.t: 根据图2 ，哪种语言的学习者人数最多？

ex.s: This got me thinking how English can be a crazy language to learn.
ex.t: 这让我想到，英语学起来可真是一门疯狂的语言。

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 您还必须惊讶于一种独特的疯狂语言，在这种语言中，房子可以在燃烧时燃烧，您可以通过填写表格来填写表格，并且只有在警报响起时才会听到警报！

ex.s: Some of the language used on the Internet is different to the language used in other forms of communication.
ex.t: 互联网上使用的一些语言与其他形式的交流中使用的语言不同。

ex.s: So I learnt a new language.
ex.t: 所以我学了一门新语言。

ex.s: Human speech contains more than 2,000 different sounds, from the common “m” and “a” to the rare clicks of some southern African languages.
ex.t: 人类语言包含2000多种不同的声音，从常见的"m"和"a"到某些南部非洲语言中罕见的咔嗒音。

ex.s: A ground-breaking, five-year study shows that diet-related changes in human bite led to new speech sounds that are now found in half the world’s languages.
ex.t: 一项开创性的五年研究表明，与人类咬合相关的饮食变化导致了新的语音，如今这些语音存在于世界上一半的语言中。

ex.s: More than 30 years ago, the scholar Charles Hockett noted that speech sounds called labiodentals, such as “f” and “v”, were more common in the languages of societies that ate softer foods.
ex.t: 30多年前，学者查尔斯·霍克特(Charles Hockett)指出，在食用软食的社会语言中，称为labiodentals的语音，如“f”和“v”更为常见。

ex.s: These sounds are still not found in the languages of many hunter-gatherer people today.
ex.t: 这些声音在今天许多狩猎采集民族的语言中仍然不存在。

ex.s: Analyses of a language database also confirmed that there was a global change in the sound of world languages after the Neolithic age, with the use of “f” and “v” increasing remarkably during the last few thousand years.
ex.t: 对一个语言数据库的分析也证实，新石器时代之后世界语言的声音发生了全球性的变化，"f"和"v"的使用在近几千年显著增加。

ex.s: However, boys tended to play with more complex puzzles than girls, and the parents of boys provided more spatial language and were more active during puzzle play than parents of girls.
ex.t: 然而，男孩往往比女孩玩更复杂的拼图，男孩的父母提供更多空间语言，并在拼图游戏中比女孩的父母更积极。

defs.def: the use by humans of a system of sounds and words to communicate 言语；说话；语言

ex.s: The Language Exchange Programme allows students in pairs to communicate in two different languages they wish to share and learn each week.
ex.t: 语言交换项目让学生两人一组，每周用两种他们希望分享和学习的不同语言进行交流。

ex.s: Our courses, totalling 20,000 hours of content in 20 different languages, guarantee you language skills you can use right away.
ex.t: 我们的课程总计2万小时内容，涵盖20种不同的语言，保证你掌握可立即使用的语言技能。

ex.s: Lancom is the only product to offer courses tailored to your native language, building on grammar and words you already know.
ex.t: Lancom是唯一提供根据母语量身定制课程的产品，在你已掌握的语法和词汇基础上进行构建。

ex.s: On a recent program, we told you the stories of English words borrowed from other languages.
ex.t: 在最近一期节目中，我们讲述了源自其他语言的英语单词的故事。

ex.s: They prefer to use more spatial language.
